NgraceRequirements.Annotation: Marketplace package and Bun CLI for Graph-RAG Anchored Code Engineering (GRACE / neo-grace).
NgraceRequirements.Keywords: grace, ngrace, lint, knowledge-graph, semantic-markup, marketplace, bun

Goals.Goal: Ship a validated CLI that lints and queries `.ngrace` artifacts without silent degradation.
Distribute GRACE skills so coding agents can init, plan, verify, and execute contract-first changes.
Keep canonical skills, packaged plugins, and published versions synchronized and path-safe.

Users.User: Maintainers of neo-grace packaging and the `@neograce/cli` binary.
Coding agents and humans who install the marketplace plugin and run `ngrace` against a project.

Constraints.Constraint: No new runtime dependencies without an explicit track decision.
`skills/ngrace/*` is source of truth; packaged mirror must stay byte-identical.
Existing valid `.ngrace` trees must keep validating; grammar changes are additive unless a plan says otherwise.
